subject: Nimbus Health — trial sprint plan & weekly checkpoints
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Claire Donovan <claire@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, dev_patel@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 10 Apr 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Nimbus Health — trial sprint plan & weekly checkpoints

Hi Claire — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and a proposed 3-week evaluation sprint so we can get measurable results before your board meeting on May 5.

Summary of success criteria (as discussed):
- End-to-end latency under 450ms for 95th percentile on standard patient-summary prompts.
- Semantic embedding similarity >= 0.82 AUC on your internal relevance eval set.
- No PII from protected fields returned in generated summaries (we'll run red-team review).
- Operational: <2% request error rate and stable KV cache hit rate >70% under typical traffic pattern.

Proposed trial sprint (timeline):
Week 0 (this week): baseline data share, identify 3 canonical prompt templates, provide test dataset subset (10k rows).
Week 1: deploy trial model variant, run throughput tests, initial quality checks.
Week 2: iterate prompts, run embedding/semantic evals, run regression tests.
Week 3: final metrics, executive summary, recommendations.

Owners:
- Karthik (sales): overall coordination, weekly executive syncs.
- Dev (dev_patel@redwood.com): runtime onboarding, config and perf tuning.
- Nimbus: Claire (product) and Raj (data) to own dataset handoff and evaluation rubric.

Next steps: can you confirm dataset delivery by EOD Monday and whether Nimbus prefers AWS us-west-2 for the trial env? I attached a short playbook and an editable success-criteria spreadsheet.

Attachments: redwood_trial_playbook.pdf, nimbus_trial_success_criteria.xlsx

Thanks — Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0128

From: Claire Donovan <claire@nimbushealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 13 Apr 2026 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Nimbus Health — trial sprint plan & weekly checkpoints

Hi Karthik — this plan looks good and aligns with our timeline. A couple of clarifications:

1) Dataset: Raj will drop a vetted subset (10k rows) into the S3 bucket by Monday EOD (we'll send IAM role details).
2) Environment: prefer us-west-2. Our procurement folks also want a short note on data residency for the trial (we keep data in-region).
3) Success criteria: can we add a simple user-acceptance task — 20 clinical reviewers should mark summaries as "clinically useful" in at least 70% of cases for the sprint to be a success.

I'll loop Raj and procurement on the next message with IAM and the procurement ask. Thanks — Claire

From: Raj Patel <raj.patel@nimbushealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Claire Donovan <claire@nimbushealth.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Apr 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Nimbus Health — trial sprint plan & weekly checkpoints

Karthik / Claire — IAM: we've created a role (arn:aws:iam::987654321:role/nimbus-redwood-trial). I'll send the credentials via our secure portal.
Procurement note: procurement@nimbushealth.com will need a short one-pager stating that trial data will remain in us-west-2 and will be deleted after 60 days unless otherwise requested.

Also attaching the internal evaluation template (we'll use this to capture the 20 reviewers' feedback).

Regards,
Raj
Senior Data Engineer | Nimbus Health

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Claire Donovan <claire@nimbushealth.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 17 Apr 2026 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Nimbus Health — trial sprint plan & weekly checkpoints

Thanks for the updates, team. Quick alignment from Redwood on the procurement/data residency ask — we confirm trial data will be processed and stored only in AWS us-west-2 for the duration of the trial and will be purged within 60 days post-trial; we'll put this in a short statement for your procurement team and sign an evidence log.

Dev — once IAM is live can you provision the trial environment with the quantized model variant we discussed (4-bit) and enable KV caching? Target baseline perf run by Mon 4/20.

Claire — we'll also schedule a 30-min kickoff on Tuesday morning to hand off the final dataset and confirm reviewer tasks. Is 10:30am PT good for you?

Best,
Lauren Bishop
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Claire Donovan <claire@nimbushealth.com>, Raj Patel <raj.patel@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, dev_patel@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 20 Apr 2026 09:11:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Nimbus Health — trial sprint plan & weekly checkpoints

Quick weekly nudge — thanks Raj for IAM and Claire for confirming the kickoff. Two quick asks before tomorrow's kickoff:
- Can you confirm the sample of 200 patient records (subset of the 10k) will be ready in the S3 path by 9am PT tomorrow? We'll use those to validate ingestion and prompt templates.
- Please share the list of 20 reviewers (emails) or the single point of contact who will distribute the review task.

If either of those slips, we can still proceed but it will push the performance baseline to Wed.

Thanks — Karthik

From: Claire Donovan <claire@nimbushealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Raj Patel <raj.patel@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: procurement@nimbushealth.com
Date: Fri, 01 May 2026 09:14:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Nimbus Health — trial sprint plan & weekly checkpoints

Hi Karthik — quick status update from our side:
- Sample 200 delivered and accessible at s3://nimbus-trial/samples/200.csv on 4/21. Access confirmed.
- 18 of 20 reviewers completed the first pass; preliminary UAT shows ~72% "clinically useful" marking — looks promising.
- Procurement received your 60-day residency note and sent a short form; we'll return signed doc next week.

Next asks: can Dev share the initial latency and error-rate numbers so we can compare against the success criteria matrix? Also, can we schedule a 20-minute sync next Thursday to review the week-2 evaluation results?

Appreciate the quick turnaround — Claire
Nimbus Health
